title: Nginx Misconfigurations
description: Three nginx servers, each with a classic configuration mistake: a CRLF injection through $uri in a redirect, an alias traversal from a location without a trailing slash, and an add_header in a location that drops the server's security headers.
question: Exploit the nginx alias misconfiguration to read /ctf/flag outside the /files/ directory, and study the CRLF and add_header mistakes on the other ports.
